posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: q-* and vmt_2* questions are above OPPE level, for you to practice. OPPE Questions are usually easier.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If you are finding these hard to solve without a time constraint, then OPPE might feel a little tight with time constraint. I would suggest going through and understanding the solutions at least for q-* ones if you are unable to solve for a long time.
